item.title: ASCO 2026 Preview
item.description:
• Summary: Ahead of the American Society of Clinical Oncology (ASCO) 2026 meeting, multiple previews highlight key abstracts. Notable data include updates from Merck and BioNTech on personalized cancer vaccines, Lilly on next-generation CDK inhibitors, Moderna on mRNA-based neoantigen therapies, and Gilead on its newly acquired Tubulis ADC platform. Other anticipated readouts involve Black Diamond Therapeutics, Arrivent Biopharma, and BeOne Medicines (formerly BeiGene). The previews also discuss the shift toward earlier disease stages and combination regimens.
  • MoAs: N/A
  • Sources: BioPharma Dive, Endpoints News, ApexOnco, ApexOnco

item.title: AI in Healthcare
item.description:
• Summary: Multiple news outlets report on the integration of artificial intelligence in healthcare. Utah's experiment with AI prescribing is ongoing, a health AI unicorn is offering its service for free to gain traction, and chatbots are being used for patient check-in and intake at doctor offices, aiming to streamline administrative processes.
  • MoAs: N/A
  • Sources: Endpoints News, Endpoints News, STAT News

item.title: Men's Health Act
item.description:
• Summary: A STAT News article covers the State of Men's Health Act, which proposes a new office but has faced legislative slowdowns. The piece discusses the act's implications for men's health policy and funding.
